property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array and any parameters, C.transfer(...) always returns (completes) when the callee's low-level transferFrom call succeeds; the mutant inverts the success check and will revert when the callee succeeds (so there exists inputs — a helper callee that returns success and a non-empty _tos — where the reference completes but the mutant reverts).
change_summary: Invert the success check to require the inner call to fail (require(!_s)), causing different observable outcomes when inner calls succeed or revert.
